name: Mean Wife
overview: Scripture teaches that in Christ all distinctions are transcended, yet within marriage God establishes distinct roles where wives are called to submit to their husbands as to the Lord, reflecting the church's submission to Christ (Ephesians 5:22-24; Galatians 3:28). Husbands are commanded to love their wives sacrificially, mirroring Christ’s love for the church (Ephesians 5:25), while wives are urged to show reverence to their husbands (Ephesians 5:33). These passages emphasize mutual respect and love within the God-ordained framework of marriage, opposing a spirit of harshness or mean-spiritedness in the wife’s conduct.
